journey.title: Dismiss suggestions with Escape while editing a saved city
journey.goal: Escape closes the suggestion list and keeps the city the user typed

functionalJourney.title: Pick a suggested city with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Typing part of a name and clicking a suggestion saves that city

guards.title: ArrowDown and Enter still select a suggestion
guards.goal: Typing Fa, ArrowDown and Enter saves Faro

plan.root_cause: The Escape key handler in the list controller clears the input value, causing the user's typed city to be lost when dismissing suggestions.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the navigate function in src/controllers/listController.js to retain the input value when Escape is pressed, only closing the suggestion list and emitting the clear event (if any).
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close the suggestion listbox (setting aria-expanded to false and hiding the list), return focus to the combobox input, and leave the input value unchanged, preserving the user's typed city while maintaining correct combobox state.
functional_risks: Consumers that rely on the 'clear' event being accompanied by an actual value reset may observe a mismatch, though the event is still emitted.
If the intent of Escape was to cancel the current input, the value will persist; however the requirement specifies Escape should retain the typed value.
verification_requirements: After typing text and pressing Escape, the suggestion list must be hidden (no visible #city-list).
Focus must return to the #city input.
The input's value must remain exactly what the user typed.
ArrowDown and Enter selection of a suggestion must continue to work.
Tab key behavior (with tabSelect) must remain unchanged.
